name: @activepieces/piece-lokalise
description: Lokalise is a collaborative translation platform.

auth.description: Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.

createComment.name: createComment
createComment.description: Add comments to a key in your Lokalise project

auth.description: Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.
Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.

comment.description: The comment text to add to the key

aiMetadata.description: Post a new comment on a specific translation key in a Lokalise project. Requires the project ID and key ID. Not idempotent: each call appends another comment.

createKey.name: createKey
createKey.description: Create one or more keys in your Lokalise project

auth.description: Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.

platforms.description: Select the platforms this key applies to

useAutomations.description: Whether to run automations on the new key translations

aiMetadata.description: Create a new translation key in a Lokalise project, tagged to one or more platforms (iOS, Android, web, etc.). Requires the project ID and key name; platforms are mandatory. Not idempotent: each call adds a key even if the name repeats.

createProject.name: createProject
createProject.description: Create a new project in your Lokalise team

baseLangIso.description: Language/locale code of the project base language (e.g., "en", "en-us")

teamId.description: ID of the team to create a project in (numerical ID or UUID). If omitted, the project will be created in your current team

aiMetadata.description: Create a new localization project in your Lokalise team, optionally setting its type, base language, and target team. Use when starting a new translation workspace. Not idempotent: repeating the call creates duplicate projects.

createTask.name: createTask
createTask.description: Create a new task in your Lokalise project

auth.description: Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.

description.description: Brief task description. Used as instructions for AI in automatic_translation and lqa_by_ai task types

keys.description: Comma-separated list of key IDs to include in the task (required unless parent_task_id is specified)

languages.description: Comma-separated language ISO codes for the task (e.g., "fr,de,es")

sourceLanguageIso.description: Source language code for the task

dueDate.description: Due date in format: Y-m-d H:i:s (e.g., "2024-12-31 23:59:59")

autoCloseLanguages.description: Whether languages should be closed automatically upon completion. Default is true

autoCloseTask.description: Whether the task should be automatically closed upon all language completion. Default is true

closingTags.description: Comma-separated tags to be added to keys when task is closed

doLockTranslations.description: If set to true, will lock translations for non-assigned project members

markVerified.description: Mark translations as verified. Only for automatic_translation tasks. Default is true

saveAiTranslationToTm.description: Save AI translations to Translation Memory. Only for automatic_translation tasks

applyAiTm100Matches.description: Apply 100% translation memory matches. Only for automatic_translation tasks

aiMetadata.description: Create a workflow task (translation, automatic translation, LQA by AI, or review) in a Lokalise project, scoped to specific keys and target languages. Use to assign translation or review work. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate task.

deleteKey.name: deleteKey
deleteKey.description: Delete a key from your Lokalise project (software and marketing projects only)

auth.description: Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.
Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently delete a translation key (and its translations) from a Lokalise project, identified by project ID and key ID. Only works for software and marketing project types. Idempotent in effect: once deleted, re-running has no further effect, though the key must currently exist.

retrieveAComment.name: retrieveAComment
retrieveAComment.description: Retrieve a specific comment on a key in your Lokalise project

auth.description: Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.
Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single comment on a translation key, identified by project ID, key ID, and comment ID. Use to read one comment's text and metadata. Read-only and idempotent.

retrieveAKey.name: retrieveAKey
retrieveAKey.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific key in your Lokalise project

auth.description: Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.
Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.

disableReferences.description: Disable key references in the response

aiMetadata.description: Fetch the details of a single translation key, including its translations and metadata, by project ID and key ID. Use to inspect a key before updating or referencing it. Read-only and idempotent.

retrieveAProject.name: retrieveAProject
retrieveAProject.description: Retrieve detailed information about a Lokalise project

auth.description: Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch the details and settings of a single Lokalise project by its project ID. Use to inspect project configuration or confirm a project exists. Read-only and idempotent.

retrieveTranslation.name: retrieveTranslation
retrieveTranslation.description: Retrieve a specific translation from your Lokalise project

auth.description: Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.

disableReferences.description: Disable key references in the translation

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single translation by its translation ID from a Lokalise project. Use to read the current value, status, and metadata of one translation. Read-only and idempotent.

updateKey.name: updateKey
updateKey.description: Update properties of a key in your Lokalise project

auth.description: Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.
Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.

keyName.description: Key identifier (or JSON with ios, android, web, other for per-platform names)

platforms.description: List of platforms enabled for this key

mergeTags.description: Enable to merge specified tags with current tags

isHidden.description: Whether this key is hidden from non-admins

context.description: Optional context of the key (used with some file formats)

charLimit.description: Maximum allowed number of characters in translations

aiMetadata.description: Update properties of an existing translation key (name, description, platforms, tags, plural/hidden/archived flags, context, character limit) identified by project ID and key ID. Idempotent: re-sending the same field values leaves the key in the same state, though enabling Merge Tags appends tags rather than replacing them.

updateTranslation.name: updateTranslation
updateTranslation.description: Update a translation in your Lokalise project

auth.description: Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.

translation.description: The actual translation content. Use JSON object format for plural keys

isUnverified.description: Whether the Unverified flag is enabled

isReviewed.description: Whether the Reviewed flag is enabled

custom_translation_status_ids.description: Comma-separated custom translation status IDs to assign (existing statuses will be replaced)

aiMetadata.description: Set the content and review flags of an existing translation, identified by project ID and translation ID. Use to write or correct a translation value. Idempotent: re-sending the same content and flags yields the same final state.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description: Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description: Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

keyAdded.name: keyAdded
keyAdded.description: Trigger when a new key is added to your Lokalise project

auth.description: Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new translation key is created in the selected Lokalise project, emitting that key. Polls the project keys list and detects keys by creation timestamp.

keyUpdated.name: keyUpdated
keyUpdated.description: Trigger when a key is updated in your Lokalise project

auth.description: Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an existing translation key is modified in the selected Lokalise project, emitting that key. Polls the project keys list and detects changes by modification timestamp.

translationUpdated.name: translationUpdated
translationUpdated.description: Trigger when a translation is updated in your Lokalise project

auth.description: Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a translation is modified in the selected Lokalise project, emitting that translation. Polls the project translations list and detects changes by modification timestamp.
